% An amsart document: a section in amsart's centered small capitals at the
% text size, and a run-in paragraph, which amsart ends with a period. Its
% proofs end in amsart's \qedsymbol, after text and with \qedhere in a
% display, and then in one the document sets.
\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{amssymb}
\begin{document}
\section{A section}
Some text.
\paragraph{A paragraph} Text after it.
\begin{proof}[Plain]
Ends in text.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Bracket]
Ends in a display.
\[ a = b \qedhere \]
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Align star]
Ends in an alignment.
\begin{align*} a &= b \\ c &= d \qedhere \end{align*}
\end{proof}
\renewcommand{\qedsymbol}{$\blacksquare$}
\begin{proof}[Changed]
Ends in text.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Changed display]
Ends in a display.
\[ a = b \qedhere \]
\end{proof}
\end{document}
